plan: With a private value of $30, I want to maximize potential profit. Since this is a first-price sealed bid auction with payment of third-highest bid, I'll aim to bid strategically. Rational opponents will also consider their value and potential opponent strategies. I'll bid slightly below my true value to create a buffer for potential profit, but not so low that I risk losing. A bid around $25-$27 seems optimal - close to my value but with room for potential earnings.

I'll bid slightly above my value to increase winning chances, but not so high that I risk negative earnings. A bid around $10-$12 seems balanced.
